description: The right plot in Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse) and the tree width for rollout search. The x-axis, labeled "Tree Width," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)", is also a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The plot displays a single data series, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers. The line shows a distinct inverted U-shaped trend: it starts at a low accuracy of approximately 19.4% at a tree width of 0, increases to a peak of 89.2% at a tree width of 20, and then decreases to 83.9% at a tree width of 40. The data points are explicitly labeled with their corresponding accuracy values.
